about_the_game:
"Warrior of Democracy" – Dive into a World of Epic Battles! This is a 2D shoot 'em up arcade game.
Get ready for an exciting adventure that will make your heart race!
"Warrior of Democracy" is an incredible 2D arcade where you, like a true hero, control a helicopter, battling endless waves of enemy fighters on your path to victory!
It’s time to take control and show what it means to be a true defender of the democratic skies!

Each level presents a new challenge, filled with unique enemies and tense moments.
Your mission is to destroy the fighters, dodge their attacks, and demonstrate agility to overcome all trials!
With each level you conquer, you will feel your power grow and the thrill of the game capture you even more!

Features:

Epic air battles
Diverse levels
Bonus system
Simple controls

So what are you waiting for? Take to the skies, destroy the enemies, and become the true hero of the democratic skies in "Warrior of Democracy"!
Get ready for battles that will remain in your memory forever!
